note: bibcite_entity is the Bibcite data model: content entities bibcite_reference (bundled by bibcite_reference_type), bibcite_contributor, bibcite_keyword; config entities bibcite_reference_type, bibcite_contributor_role, bibcite_contributor_category; config objects bibcite_entity.reference.settings (citekey.pattern etc.) and bibcite_entity.contributor.settings; plugin type bibcite_link (doi/google_scholar/pubmed/pubmedcentral). Medium/hard cases are grounded in the config entities and config objects (creating/reading reference types, contributor roles, and the citekey pattern) - all router-safe on this site. NOTE: on this shared site bibcite_entity's field-storage tables were not fully installed, so creating bibcite_reference CONTENT fails (missing tables); cases therefore use the config entities/settings, not content references.

evals.prompt: Which content entity types does the bibcite_entity module provide for storing bibliographic data, and what config entity provides the reference 'bundles'?
evals.expected_output: Content entities bibcite_reference (bibliographic records), bibcite_contributor (authors/editors) and bibcite_keyword (subject tags). Reference bundles are bibcite_reference_type config entities (book, journal_article, thesis, ...).

evals.prompt: What is the bibcite_link plugin type in bibcite_entity for, and which link plugins ship with it?
evals.expected_output: bibcite_link plugins add external links to a rendered reference. Shipped plugins: doi, google_scholar, pubmed, pubmedcentral (manager plugin.manager.bibcite_link, discovery Plugin/bibcite/link).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a custom bibliographic reference type has been added via bibcite. Inspect the bibcite_reference_type configuration entities and give the machine id of the custom reference type.
evals.expected_output: The reference type is bibcite_known_type (label 'Bibcite Known Type'), a bibcite_reference_type config entity.

evals.prompt: What citation-key (citekey) pattern is currently configured for bibcite references on this site? Inspect the live bibcite reference settings to answer.
On this Drupal site, add a new bibliographic reference type to bibcite with machine id 'bibcite_task_type' and label 'Working Paper'. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a bibcite_reference_type config entity: Drupal\bibcite_entity\Entity\ReferenceType::create(['id' => 'bibcite_task_type', 'label' => 'Working Paper'])->save(); (or via the reference types admin UI).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a new bibcite contributor role with machine id 'bibcite_reviewer' and label 'Reviewer'. Apply it to the live site.
